text:
Lina (PM): dropping a quick prototype for the streaming chat controls + prompt tray. main concerns: stop/regenerate wording, where to show tokens, and prompt library keyboard flow. Figma: https://figma.com/file/abc. Evan (Designer): compact controls look good. a11y nit: buttons need full accessible names (avoid just icons). e.g. 'Stop generation' not 'Stop'. Also ensure 44px tap targets. Sam (Frontend): re: screen readers, current approach uses aria-live="polite" and aria-atomic="true" which causes whole chunk to reannounce. Recommend aria-atomic="false" and role="status"; also mark partial updates with visually-hidden deltas. Maya (Eng): important: stopping is non-destructive. it interrupts the stream and keeps generated text. that should inform copy. 'Stop' vs 'Pause' vs 'Interrupt' debate. Darla (Content): low friction language favours 'Stop generation' and 'Regenerate response'. tooltips can clarify effects: 'Stops current response; you can regenerate.' Lina (PM): keyboard shortcuts? thinking Esc for stop might conflict. propose Cmd/Ctrl+. for stop and Cmd/Ctrl+Enter for regenerate. thoughts. Sam (Frontend): Esc overlaps with modal close. Cmd/Ctrl+. is fine. we should expose shortcuts in tooltip and in the accessibility help dialog. also need focus styles on control group. a11y-bot: Checklist: accessible names, role=status for stream, aria-atomic=false, focus order, skip link for prompt library, 4.5:1 contrast, 44px targets. Evan (Designer): token counter placement: on desktop show right of send row; on mobile collapse into a small chevron that expands. visual idea: show a fleeting +N token delta bubble per chunk then merge into total to reduce flicker. Maya (Eng): backend note: streaming token counts are estimates during generation. we'll send an "estimated_tokens" field and a final "tokens" on completion. frontend should debounce updates (200ms) to avoid layout thrash. Sam (Frontend): small code hint: ```
New chunk appended
``` and use aria-hidden on the token delta animation so it doesn't spam SRs. Darla (Content): microcopy proposals: - Stop: 'Stop generation' (tooltip: 'Interrupt the current response; content so far will stay') - Regenerate: 'Regenerate response' (tooltip: 'Send the same prompt again') - Tokens: 'Tokens: 123' with optional cost tooltip for paid plans Evan (Designer): accessibility: ensure the prompt tray is navigable by keyboard and SR announces "Prompt library. X items" when opened. avoid modal traps; prefer a slide-over drawer with focus return. Lina (PM): decision: use 'Stop generation' and 'Regenerate response'. keyboard: Cmd/Ctrl+. to stop, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter to regenerate. Prompt tray = slide-over with skip link and announced count. Sam (Frontend): i'll implement aria changes, focus styles, and the shortcut wiring. will PR today. Maya (Eng): i'll add estimated vs final tokens to websocket payload and apply a debounce on token updates. Evan (Designer): i'll update figma frames for desktop/mobile and add the token-delta animation prototype. Darla (Content): i'll land final microcopy and tooltips. a11y-bot: Added quick issue checklist to thread. Lina (PM): thanks all. sync Monday 10am for final sign-off. :thumbsup:
